tr.title: Hakyol — Namaz Vakti, Kıble ve Kur'an Uygulaması

en.title: Hakyol — Prayer Times, Qibla & Quran App
en.description: Prayer times, qibla direction, the Holy Quran, dhikr counter, the 99 Names of Allah and Kaaba live stream in one app. Free on iOS and Android.

id.title: Hakyol — Aplikasi Waktu Salat, Kiblat & Al-Qur'an
